layman_headline: Market fear is high and altcoins are bleeding — not the time to jump in.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood right now, scoring only 27 out of 100 on the sentiment scale. Bitcoin is down about 2% this week while most altcoins are doing worse, some dropping 10-12%. The few coins showing green — like KAITO and ADA — have already run up so much that buying now means chasing a move that's likely overextended. There's no clear, safe entry point among the candidates today.
layman_action: Stay on the sidelines and keep your cash ready. Wait for either a deeper pullback that creates genuinely oversold conditions with a clear support level, or for the market mood to start improving before committing capital.
expert_reasoning: I evaluated all 7 swing candidates against my validated rules and signal credibility data. KAITO shows RSI 87 — extremely overbought — and my most reliable signal (RSI at 71% win rate) strongly argues against buying here; the Three White Soldiers pattern is bullish but the risk/reward at 0.67x is unacceptable. BONK and TRUMP have oversold RSIs (29 and 27 respectively), which historically favor bounces, but both have bearish engulfing patterns, below-all-MA structures, and chart bias scores of -1.4 and -0.7 — the technical structure contradicts the RSI signal. FET and PEPE are similarly bearish. With Fear & Greed at 27 and worsening, my validated Rule #3 applies: at this level the outlook is genuinely ambiguous, and HOLD is the safer call. BTC dominance at 56.3% further suppresses alt season potential.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed at 27 and worsening could cascade into deeper sell-off across alts
Cold wallet hack affecting 4,500 addresses ($89M losses) could trigger further contagion fear
BTC dominance at 56.3% actively suppressing altcoin performance — alts could bleed further
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — watch for a move below 25 (extreme fear, per Rule #3) or recovery above 35 as directional signal
BONK and TRUMP RSI — if RSI drops below 25 while price holds current support, oversold bounce setup strengthens
ADA momentum — up 13.2% on the week with 8.6% today and real volume ($540M); if it pulls back 5-8% it could become a quality entry
market_context: Crypto markets are in a fear regime (27/100) with BTC down 2% weekly and high dominance (56.3%) squeezing altcoins. Negative headlines around the cold wallet hack and Trump Media BTC selling add to the cautious tone, though no macro panic event is unfolding.
context_banner: Fear-driven market with no clean swing setups — patience is the highest-conviction play right now.

KAITO RSI at 87 (extremely overbought) argues strongly against entry; BONK at 29 and TRUMP at 27 are oversold but lack reversal confirmation — RSI is my most reliable signal at 71% win rate.
